context_for_next_testing_agent: The che168 URL parsing fix is working correctly. The parse-url endpoint now routes che168/autohome/taoche URLs through Che168API.get_offer_details(inner_id) instead of direct scraping. The inner_id is extracted from URL using regex pattern: last 5+ digit number before .html. Tested with real che168 offer (inner_id: 53756888) - successfully extracted Changan Eado 2013 ¥6,000 with image URL. Frontend flow: paste URL → click parse → see extracted data with Belarus price calculation → click 'Добавить в гараж' → car added with success toast.

parse_url_che168_fix.fix_description: Routes che168/autohome/taoche URLs through Che168 API instead of direct scraping (which was blocked by anti-bot JS)
parse_url_che168_fix.inner_id_extraction: Regex pattern: /(\d{5,})\.html/ or fallback to last 5+ digit sequence

notes: The fix successfully resolves the issue where che168.com was blocking direct scraping with JavaScript anti-bot protection. By routing through the existing Che168 API (auto-api.com), the parse-url endpoint now correctly extracts car data including brand, model, year, price, mileage, and image URL. The frontend displays the extracted data with Belarus price calculation and allows adding the car to the garage.
